title: Map your app once, test it everywhere: navigation trees in VirtualPyTest
description:
Every screen becomes a node, every transition an edge. Map the app once and every test reuses the map: change a screen once, and every test that crosses it follows.

In this video, the YouTube web app mapped in the tree editor, a real device attached from inside the editor, and a single goto command that computes the path and performs the clicks on a real browser. The run ends in a report where every hop is a step with its timing, screenshots and the DOM it saw.

Works the same on set-top boxes, Android TV, phones and web apps.
